verses.geez: ብፁዕ፡ ዘኢይድኅፅ፡ በአፉሁ፡ ወለኃጥእሰ፡ ኢያደነግፆ፡ ሐዘን።
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that hath not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins.

translations.lxx: Blessed is the man that hath not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins.
translations.ron: Fericit bărbatul care n-a alunecat cu gura sa şi nu se răneşte cu amărăciunea păcatului.

verses.geez: ብፁዕ፡ ዘኢየሐዝን፡ ነፍሶ፡ ወዘኢሀጕል፡ ተስፋሁ።
verses.translation: Blessed is he whose conscience hath not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in the Lord.

translations.lxx: Blessed is he whose conscience hath not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in the Lord.
translations.ron: Fericit este cel pe care nu-l învinovăţeşte sufletul lui şi care n-a căzut de la nădejdea sa.

verses.geez: ለብእሲ፡ ዘኢየአምር፡ ቃለ፡ ኢይደልዎ፡ ብዕል፡ ወለብእሲ፡ ጠዋዒ፡ ኢይደልዎ፡ ንዋይ።
verses.translation: Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money?

translations.lxx: Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money?
translations.ron: Bărbatului zgârcit nu-i sunt bune avuţiile, şi omul pizmătăreţ ce înţelege din averea sa?

verses.geez: ዘይቄቅያ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ይዘግብ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ወካልእ፡ ይፌግዕ፡ በንዋዩ።
verses.translation: He that gathereth by defrauding his own soul gathereth for others that shall spend his goods riotously.

translations.lxx: He that gathereth by defrauding his own soul gathereth for others that shall spend his goods riotously.
translations.ron: Cel care adună, lipsindu-se pe sine, altora adună şi cu bunătăţile lui alţii se vor desfăta.

verses.geez: ዘለነፍሱ፡ ይጠውዕ፡ ለመኑ፡ ሀለዎ፡ ይጸጉ፡ ወዘኢይትፌሣሕ፡ በንዋዩ።
verses.translation: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods.

translations.lxx: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods.
translations.ron: Cel care este rău pentru el însuşi cui va fi bun? Şi nu se va veseli cu averile sale.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘየአክዮ፡ እምዘይጠውያ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይከውኖ፡ ፍዳሃ፡ ለእከይሁ።
verses.translation: There is none worse than he that envieth himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness.

translations.lxx: There is none worse than he that envieth himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness.
translations.ron: Nimic nu este mai rău decât cel care se pizmuieşte pe sine; şi aceasta este răsplătirea răutăţii lui.

verses.geez: ወሶበኒ፡ ያሤኒ፡ አመ፡ ረስዐ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ያሤኒ፡ ወድኅረ፡ ያዔውቅ፡ እከይሁ።
verses.translation: And if he doeth good, he doeth it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness.

translations.lxx: And if he doeth good, he doeth it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness.
translations.ron: Şi de face bine, din uitare face; iar mai pe urmă arată răutatea sa.

verses.geez: እኩይ፡ ዐይነ፡ ጠዋዒ፡ ዘይመይጥ፡ ገጾ፡ ይትዔወር፡ ነፍሶ።
verses.translation: The envious man hath a wicked eye; he turneth away his face, and despiseth men.

translations.lxx: The envious man hath a wicked eye; he turneth away his face, and despiseth men.
translations.ron: Rău este cel care pizmuieşte cu ochiul, Şi cel care îşi întoarce fata, şi cel care trece cu vederea sufletele.

verses.geez: ኢያጸግቦ፡ ክፍሉ፡ ለዐይነ፡ ሥሡዕ፡ ወእከየ፡ ልቡ፡ ያቋቊዖ፡ ለአዕፅምቲሁ።
verses.translation: A covetous man's eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked drieth up his soul.

translations.lxx: A covetous man's eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked drieth up his soul.
translations.ron: Ochiul lacomului nu se satură cu partea sa şi nedreptatea celui rău usucă sufletul.

verses.geez: ዐይኑ፡ ለሐማሚ፡ ይጠውዕ፡ እክለ፡ ወይደነግፁ፡ በውስተ፡ ማእድ።
verses.translation: A wicked eye envieth [his] bread, and he is a niggard at his table.

translations.lxx: A wicked eye envieth [his] bread, and he is a niggard at his table.
translations.ron: Ochiul rău pizmuieşte pentru pâine şi la masa sa va fi lipsit.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ በአምጣነ፡ ትክል፡ አስተደልዋ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ ወአብእ፡ መባአ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በዘይደልወከ።
verses.translation: My son, according to thy ability do good to thyself, and give the Lord his due offering.

translations.lxx: My son, according to thy ability do good to thyself, and give the Lord his due offering.
translations.ron: Fiule! Cât vei putea fă-ţi bine ţie şi adu Domnului prinoase vrednice.

verses.geez: ወተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ኢይጐነዲ፡ ሞት፡ ወኢታስተሐዘብከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞት።
verses.translation: Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not shewed unto thee.

translations.lxx: Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not shewed unto thee.
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte că moartea nu zăboveşte şi hotărârea morţii nu ţi s-a arătat.

verses.geez: ዘእንበለ፡ ትሙት፡ አሠኒ፡ ለቢጽከ፡ ወበአምጣነ፡ ትክል፡ ስፋሕ፡ እዴከ፡ ወሀብ።
verses.translation: Do good unto thy friend before thou die, and according to thy ability stretch out thy hand and give to him.

translations.lxx: Do good unto thy friend before thou die, and according to thy ability stretch out thy hand and give to him.
translations.ron: Mai înainte de a muri fă bine prietenului şi după cât poţi întinde şi dă lui.

verses.geez: ወኢትትኀጣእ፡[እም]ዕለተ፡ ትፍሥሕት(ከ)፤ ወመክፈልተ፡ ሠናይ፡ ኢያምሥጥከ።
verses.translation: Defraud not thyself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass thee.

translations.lxx: Defraud not thyself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass thee.
translations.ron: Nu lăsa nici o zi bună să treacă fără folos şi partea ta din bucuria cuviincioasă să nu te treacă.

verses.geez: አኮኑ፡ ለባዕድ፡ ተኀድጎ፡ ለጻማከ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ተግባረከ፡ ይትካፈሉ፡ መዋርስቲከ።
verses.translation: Shalt thou not leave thy travails unto another? and thy labours to be divided by lot?

translations.lxx: Shalt thou not leave thy travails unto another? and thy labours to be divided by lot?
translations.ron: Oare nu altora vei lăsa averea ta şi bunurile tale nu vor fi împărţite la sorţi?

verses.geez: ንሣእ፡ ወሀብ፡ ወአስተፍሥሓ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘትረክብ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ በውስተ፡ መቃብር።
verses.translation: Give, and take, and sanctify thy soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave.

translations.lxx: Give, and take, and sanctify thy soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave.
translations.ron: Dă şi ia şi sfinţeşte-ţi sufletul; că în şeol nu este a căuta desfătări.

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ ይበሊ፡ ከመ፡ ልብስ፡ እስመ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ሕግ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ ሞተ፡ ትሙት።
verses.translation: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, Thou shalt die the death.

translations.lxx: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, Thou shalt die the death.
translations.ron: Tot trupul ca o haină se învecheşte, că legătură din veac este cu moarte a muri.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ቈጽለ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘጽፉቅ፡ ቈጽሉ፡ ዘቀዳሚ፡ ይትነገፍ፡ ወደኃሪ፡ ይሠርጽ፡ ከማሁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ ወደም፡ ዘዝክቱ፡ ይትወለድ፡ ወዝክቱ፡ ይመውት።
verses.translation: As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow: so is the generation of flesh and blood, one cometh to an end, and another is born.

translations.lxx: As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow: so is the generation of flesh and blood, one cometh to an end, and another is born.
translations.ron: Ca frunzele cele ce înverzesc în capac des, unele cad, altele răsar,

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ይበሊ፡ ወየኀልቅ፡ ምስሌሁ።
verses.translation: Every work rotteth and consumeth away, and the worker thereof shall go withal.

translations.lxx: Every work rotteth and consumeth away, and the worker thereof shall go withal.
translations.ron: Aşa este rodul trupului şi al sângelui: unul moare şi altul se naşte.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ብእሲ፡ እንዘ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘሞተ፡ ወዘተምህረ፡ ወዐቀበ፡ ጥበቢሁ።
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that doth meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding.

translations.lxx: Blessed is the man that doth meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding.
translations.ron: Tot lucrul ce se strică se sfârşeşte, şi cel ce-l face se va duce cu el.

verses.geez: ወዘይኄሊ፡ ፍናዊሃ፡ ለጥበብ፡ በልቡ፡ ወይትሜሃር፡ ኅቡአቲሃ።
verses.translation: He that considereth her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets.

translations.lxx: He that considereth her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets.
translations.ron: Fericit bărbatul care întru înţelepciune se va sfârşi şi care va vorbi cu pricepere;

verses.geez: ትልዋ፡ ድኅሬሃ፡ ወኅሥሣ፡ አሠራ፡ ወዕቀብ፡ ፍናዊሃ።
verses.translation: Go after her as one that traceth, and lie in wait in her ways.

translations.lxx: Go after her as one that traceth, and lie in wait in her ways.
translations.ron: Cel care socoteşte căile ei în inima sa şi cele ascunse ale ei le gândeşte;

verses.geez: ዘይሔውጽ፡ እንተ፡ መሳክዊሃ፡ ወያፀምእ፡ በውስተ፡ አናቅጺሃ።
verses.translation: He that prieth in at her windows shall also hearken at her doors.

translations.lxx: He that prieth in at her windows shall also hearken at her doors.
translations.ron: Cel care aleargă după ea ca un iscoditor şi la căile ei priveghează;

verses.geez: ወዘየኀድር፡ ቅሩበ፡ ቤታ፡ ወይተክል፡ መታክሊሁ፡ ውስተ፡ አረፋቲሃ።
verses.translation: He that doth lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls.

translations.lxx: He that doth lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls.
translations.ron: Cel care se uită pe ferestrele ei şi la uşile ei ascultă.

verses.geez: ወያቀውም፡ ደብተራሁ፡ ውስተ፡ እደዊሃ፡ ወየኀችር፡ ውስተ፡ መኃድሪሃ፡ ሠናይ።
verses.translation: He shall pitch his tent nigh unto her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are.

translations.lxx: He shall pitch his tent nigh unto her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are.
translations.ron: Cel care sălăşluieşte aproape de casa ei va împlânta ţăruşii în pereţii ei, va întinde cortul său în preajma ei şi se va sălăşlui întru odihna bunătăţilor.

verses.geez: ወያነብር፡ ውሉዶ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላሎታ፡ ወይበይት፡ ታሕተ፡ አዕጹቂሃ።
verses.translation: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches.

translations.lxx: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches.
translations.ron: Va pune pe fiii săi sub acoperământul ei, şi sub ramurile ei va petrece.

verses.geez: ወያጸልል፡ እምነ፡ መርቄ፡ ታሕቴሃ፡ ወያዐርፍ፡ በውስተ፡ ክብራ።
verses.translation: By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell.

translations.lxx: By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell.
translations.ron: Va scăpa sub ea de fierbinţeală şi întru mărirea ei se va odihni.
